fields.label: Debug mode
fields.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Disable in production (live mode).

fields.label: New conversation — max per window
fields.description: Counter only increments when a brand-new conversation row is created. Opening an existing chat is free.

fields.label: iOS — New conversation max per window
fields.description: Applied when the client sends X-Client-Platform: ios.

fields.label: iOS — Nickname search max per window
iOS — Message send max per window
iOS — Attachment send max per window
Message server retention (days)
fields.description: How many days the server keeps message rows before pruning. 0 = server-amnesic.

fields.label: Suggested client retention (days)
fields.description: Suggested client-side retention. Well-behaved clients shorten but never extend beyond this value.

fields.label: Attachment server retention (days)
fields.description: Server-side retention for attachment objects, read by the attachment prune.

fields.label: Max message envelope size (bytes)
fields.description: Upper bound on message envelope size in bytes (ciphertext + fan-out header + padding).

fields.label: Retention prune schedule (cron, UTC)
fields.description: 5-field crontab (UTC) for the daily server-retention prune. Default '0 3 * * *' (03:00 UTC). The job hard-deletes message rows older than the server retention plus their attachments.

fields.label: SSE fan-out backend

options.label: Redis (require Redis, fail loud — recommended for prod)
Auto (prefer Redis, degrade to in-process if down)

fields.description: How real-time SSE events fan out across gunicorn workers. 'redis' fails loud if Redis is unreachable; 'auto' warns and degrades to a single-worker in-process bus; 'memory' is always in-process.

fields.label: Redis channel prefix
fields.description: Redis pub/sub channel namespace prefix for SSE fan-out. The per-worker listener psubscribes '<prefix>*'; keep it unique to meinchat so the pattern cannot catch foreign channels.

fields.label: Max SSE stream lifetime (seconds)
fields.description: Server-side lifetime cap for each SSE stream. On reaching it the stream closes and the browser's EventSource auto-reconnects — prevents an idle connection from pinning a worker/DB connection indefinitely.

fields.label: Meter guest bot-widget chats
fields.description: When on, a public bot-widget guest is granted initial tokens on activation and spends them per word (questions AND bot answers, 1 token = 1 word). When off, guest chats are free (no grant, no metering).

fields.label: Initial guest tokens (granted on activation)
fields.description: Tokens credited to a freshly provisioned widget guest. Granted only to a NEW guest — a returning guest reusing its session is not re-granted.

fields.label: Token cost per word
fields.description: Tokens charged per word (1 token = 1 word). Both the guest's question words and the bot's answer words are debited from the guest. Set 0 to disable per-word charging.

fields.label: Token bundles page link
fields.description: URL the out-of-tokens "Buy tokens" button links to (e.g. /tokens or a CMS pricing page).
